name: Synthflow
tagline: No-code voice AI for enterprise call automation
description: Synthflow is a no-code voice AI platform aimed at non-developer teams deploying call automation — appointment scheduling, lead qualification, basic support. $20M raise in June 2025. Pricing model has been in flux as the company moves from pure usage-based to tiered subscriptions.
pricingDetails: Voice: $0.09/min + LLM $0.02-$0.04/min. Tiered plans reportedly $29-$249/month. Enterprise: ~$15K/year minimum.
